signals.title: Fabric IQ in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Cowork
signals.product: Fabric IQ; Microsoft Copilot; Power BI semantic models
signals.summary: Governed Power BI reports and semantic models can now ground answers in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Cowork, so users get answers based on the same measures and definitions used in existing reports.
details: Announced as generally available for Copilot Chat and Cowork.
Copilot infers which report or semantic model fits the question; in Cowork, Power BI content can take part in long-running, asynchronous tasks.

Responses cite the Power BI content behind an answer and show the Microsoft Purview label applied to it; Power BI permissions and row-level security determine which content a user can reach (Power BI September feature summary).
Microsoft Purview DLP policies and information protection controls are supported for this experience (Power BI September feature summary).
The hero blog says customers get these insights “without additional AI token costs”. It does not say there are no license or capacity requirements.

Legacy relevance note: Business users could ask questions over certified claims, underwriting or finance semantic models in the flow of work, reusing existing definitions, row-level security and sensitivity labels.

Prerequisite: Licensing, capacity and tenant-setting requirements are not detailed in the retrieved announcement text. “No additional AI token costs” must not be read as free of license or capacity cost.
signals.author: Arun Ulag
tags: Fabric IQ; Microsoft Copilot; Power BI semantic models
AI grounded in trusted enterprise data
signals.nextStep: Pick one certified semantic model and a small business group, compare Copilot answers with existing reports, and confirm licensing, tenant settings and data-protection posture with Microsoft.

A Fabric admin portal setting controls the navigation entry point and is off by default.
The setting is independent of the existing standalone Power BI Copilot setting.

signals.product: Fabric Apps; Fabric SQL database; Warehouse; Lakehouse; semantic models
